messages:
Maya R: Heads-up — running a weekend load test Sat 02:00-10:00 UTC, need ~8 H100 slots in europe-west (uk-west) for an inference canary. Anyone have headroom or a fallback? :eyes:
Context: burst test against ded-pool autoscale, model redwood/gpt-xxl, seq len ~512. If vendor capacity isn't there, can we accept 2x A100 as fallbacks? Need decision by EOD today.

Jon P: We have 4 standby H100 reserved in eu-west already. I can free up 2 more by preempting a training job (low impact) but not the full 8. What's the hard minimum? We can also split across regions if that helps.

Sarah L: If you want a quota bump on GCP, open a ticket today — quota changes often take 4-24h. I can file one if you give project + machine type. Quick note: example gcloud check command: `gcloud compute regions describe europe-west2 --project=redwood-inference` and `gcloud compute quotas list --region=europe-west2`

ProcurementBot: Vendor update from CloudPartner: +6 H100 possible for Sat (preseeded fleet), tentative ETA confirmed. Ref: ticket CP-5932. Pricing note: short-term add-on has premium ~+15%.

Leo C: If we mix GPU types, please add telemetry labels so cost and perf evals don't overlap. Suggested labels: `labels: test=weekend-loadtest,owner=maya,run=2025-06-14`. I'll pre-create the cost center tag.

Oncall Ops: We can do a slot-swap at 00:30 UTC but need a rollback plan and quick smoke tests (latency P90, error-rate). Please add a 5-step runbook and a health-check script. Ping me 2h before swap.

Maya R: Ack. If we can only secure 6 H100, plan becomes: 6 H100 + 2 A100 fallback (eu-west1). Can we auto-route so requests prefer H100 and fall back to A100?

Jon P: @Maya I can add a routing policy: prefer `h100-eu` and fallback to `a100-eu`. I'll open a tiny PR in infra-alloc with `preferred: ["h100-eu"], fallback: ["a100-eu"]` and a cost estimate. Expect PR in the next hour.

Leo C: Telemetry tags added: `costcenter=loadtest-weekend-2025-06-14`, `owner=maya`. I also created a billing alert for unexpected spend.

Sarah L: Filed GCP quota ticket and included the project details + CP-5932 vendor note. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/compute/quotas?project=redwood-inference&tickets=CP-5932 — approval ETA 12-18h but vendor preseed may be faster.

Maya R: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll write the 5-step runbook (include smoke script & revert) and post final plan here by EOD so Oncall can sign-off.

Jon P: FYI I'll add a simple smoke script to infra repo: `scripts/smoke_loadtest.sh` that runs 50 short requests and checks p50/p95/p99 and error rates.

Oncall Ops: Great. Once runbook and PR are up, drop an @oncall-ops ping and we'll schedule the swap window.

Maya R: Will do.
